items.content_text: Slow, sexy and sad jams that'll get you right in the feels.

items.title: RA.1047 deep creep
items.content_text: 77 minutes of wickedly twitchy grooves from the belly of the New York underground.

items.title: New listening bar ESCUTA set to open in Rio de Janeiro
items.content_text: Located on Rua General Polidoro, the venue will span three floors and have its own radio station.

items.title: Eris Drew and Octo Octa announce debut album as Alchemical Sisters
items.content_text: The duo's record will be released in October via Interdimensional Transmissions.

items.title: New open-air club SELVA opens in Sicily
items.content_text: The Ragusa venue hosted Roi Perez, Francesco Maria and Andrea Saba across its opening events.

items.title: Man assaulted by 30-plus people at Sardinia beach bar in alleged homophobic attack
items.content_text: Angelo Ratti, founder of queer DJ collective Biscotto della Fortuna, said he was beaten by a group after being subjected to homophobic abuse at a beach bar near Olbia.

items.title: San Francisco's Portola Festival reveals slate of satellite shows
items.content_text: Soulwax, Ben UFO, Overmono, Fatboy Slim, Horsegiirl and more will perform in the city throughout the weekend festival.

items.title: New York's Japan Society announces retrospective film series, Music by Ryuichi Sakamoto
items.content_text: The two day event will feature rarely-seen films scored by the late composer.

items.title: DFA Records releases 'The Whole Of The Moon' tribute to Optimo's JD Twitch
items.content_text: The one-time release from supergroup The Watergirls features Teamy, Mhairi McClymont, James Murphy, Bob Weston and more.

items.title: Yasuaki Shimizu scores film on Nagasaki atomic bomb survivors
items.content_text: The Japanese ambient legend's soundtrack for The Man Who Brings the Voice of August is out now.

items.title: Paisley's Club 69 to close after 37 years
items.content_text: The legendary basement venue will close in October.

items.title: Rotterdam festivals face €656,000 annual funding cut
items.content_text: A petition has been launched in opposition of the cuts.

items.title: Ghost Dubs announces new album Oblique
items.content_text: Lead single "Low Times" features remixes by The Bug.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Shlohmo
items.content_text: Chopped, screwed and slowed, but never slopped.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Jocelyn
items.content_text: Polymorphous techno, bass and breaks recorded live at Berserker.

items.title: Atlanta festival TWISTED LINES announces debut lineup
items.content_text: The warehouse event will feature sets from BAUGRUPPE90, Onlynumbers, Kobosil and more.
